      @Transactional(readOnly=true) public Address getAddress(Long id, PUser requestingUser)
      Reads the department's address as a detached copy, initialized inside this transaction (see CompanyService.getMainAddress(java.lang.Long, de.hallerweb.enterprise.prioritize.model.security.PUser)). Returns null if the department has no address.

    • getAllDepartments

      @Transactional(readOnly=true) public List<Department> getAllDepartments()
      Returns every department across all companies. Intended for admin-console screens (e.g. the role editor's optional department scope selector); carries no per-call authorization, mirroring getDepartmentById(java.lang.Long) and the sibling admin services.
